info.name: ETFC Fight Night API
info.description:
Customer-facing REST API for the ETFC Fight Night betting platform.

**Base URL**: `{{base_url}}/api/v1`

**Auth**: Bearer token via Sanctum. After calling Login or Register, the token is automatically saved to `{{token}}` by the test script — all protected requests will use it automatically.

**Flow**:
1. Register / Login → token auto-saved
2. Browse Cities → get `city_id` and `city_event_id`
3. Build bet slip → POST /bets/multi
4. Check /bets and /wallet

variable.description: Update after calling Get City Fight Card
Returned as city_event_id in event objects
Update from betting_options in event response

request.description: Returns all active cities. Copy an `id` into the `city_id` variable.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Returns city details + full open fight card. Each event includes `city_event_id` and `betting_options` — you need both to place a bet.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Returns a single event with all betting options for the given city.

response.name: 200 OK

item.description: Register and login. The token is auto-saved to `{{token}}` via test scripts.

request.description:
Create a new customer account. Token is auto-saved to `{{token}}` on success.

**Rate limit**: 5 requests/minute per IP.

Change `phone` to a unique value if this number is already registered.

request.description:
Authenticate with phone + password. Token is auto-saved to `{{token}}`.

**Rate limit**: 5 requests/minute per IP.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Returns the authenticated user profile + wallet balance summary.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Revokes the current Bearer token. You will need to login again.

item.name: 🎲 Bets
item.description:
Place and view bets. All endpoints require authentication.

Customers can only bet on events in their registered city.

request.description:
Returns all bets placed by the authenticated user, newest first. 20 per page.

**Tax formula** (apply client-side — API returns gross `potential_payout`):
```
profit   = potential_payout − stake
tax      = profit × 0.15
net      = potential_payout − tax
```

request.description:
**Primary bet slip endpoint.** Place up to 10 bets in a single atomic transaction.

Get `city_event_id` and `betting_option_id` from the **Get City Fight Card** response.

**All or nothing** — if any bet fails validation or the total stake exceeds your balance, zero bets are placed.

Update `city_event_id` and `betting_option_id` values from a real **Get City Fight Card** call before sending.
